intent.summary: Instantiates a pattern subtree once for each item in an identified data sequence.
useWhen: A repeated subtree is driven by data
avoidWhen: Items require collection interaction that should be modeled as a list

semantics.childPolicy: one template subtree evaluated per data item
semantics.sizing: determined by parent layout and instantiated children

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Pattern subtree instantiated for each item.

constraints.expression: identity is stable and unique within items
constraints.message: Repeated instances require stable unique identity.

accessibility.focusBehavior: generated descendants participate in normal order
notes: The structural operator itself is not exposed.

mappings.strategy: Capture sequence, identity, and content closure separately.
Bind the sequence and translate the template subtree.
Map through Qt Quick or Qt Widgets constructs using the same layout intent and accessibility contract.
caveats: Qt Quick and Qt Widgets differ in sizing, ownership, and event wiring.
